book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Kx Ayrnrngr Mz Timoti

content: Nim la Timoti, ninge Pol, aposol kc tqmcpx Mevalu Jiszs, mz nzvz-nqblq-krde natq Gct kc tqarlapxle nigu, ncdr Mevalu Jiszs kc tqbrti drtwrgu. Nzatwzlr-ngrdr ninge mz nzwztr-krbo badr. Apubo bam trtem angidr mz nzrlxngiti-krgi. X krka'-ngrne kx Gct Trtegu x Kxetu rgu Mevalu Jiszs nayc mz drtwrdr nim x naokatrlr nim mz zmrlz ngrdr kxmyalz x namnc-zpwxq.

Mzli kc tqmncbe-ngrgi mz taon Efiszs, pibo bam kx namncme elr, x ninge kc tqvzpex mz provins kc Masedonia. X mzli ka suti drtwrnge kx namncbeq elr, murde na-atubqtibzme nzalvztrkr leplz kcng tzalvztr-rbrng.
Pibz badr kx bzkq nzamatqlr be kc bqnc tzpokiangr x pepz kc tqyrlwrlz-ngrm drtq melrmqdrng. Da lcng tqrkatrpz nzakipx-lzbqkr leplz, a' trnzokatrlru nzwzkr Gct kc tqvzpxm mz nzrlxngitingr.
Timoti, suti drtwrnge kx nivz navzpxm mz nzalvztr-krgi, murde nabz leplz neging natubq, nqmq nr drtwrdr trnavz-rbru, x nzrlxngiti-krdr natu-amqngi mz nzmrlzti-lzbq-krdr.
Murde kzdung leplz nzesablqtipelr da lcng tqmrlz, murde naprtrng mz nzycmnengr kx trokatrleu leplz.
Nzrpilr nanginidr kxnzalvztr mz Lou sc Mosis, a' trtakitrdeu. Murde kxmule-esz' natqdr tubq mz drtwrdr esz'-krdr, a' trnzkrlzlru da kcng tzycmnetr-ngrdr x drtwr ngrde.

Krlzku kx Loukxtr okatrle leplz mzli kc tzvz-nqblq-ngrdr drtwr ngrde angidr. X drtwr ngr Loukxtr naesz'ting mz drtwr ngr Nrpakxmrlz kc tqaprcm Gct kc tqmyalz bange. Murde yrlq-ngrbzle Loukxtr trngiu dalr nzatubqtingr leplz kxnztubqng, a' mz nzatubqti-krde leplz kxnzvz-rbrng murde nzrpwa'-ngrdr Loukxtr x nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzvz-nqblq-krdrle. Nidr leplz kxnzatrkatilr Gct, kxnzaleng alwx, kxnzpxtxpx-ngrdr Gct x kxnzpxtxpx-ngrdr da kxtrng amrlx. X nidr leplz kxnznibqlr trtedr x lxedr, x leplz kc-kzng, x kxnzrmwiming badr doa kx trngiu krnalzdr, x ncblo badr ncblo, x olvz badr olvz. Nidr kxnzpnang doa kx na-amwalrng, kxnzpokiang, x kxnzpokiang mz mz kxnzetung mz kot, x kxnzaleng da kx rpwa'-ngrde Nrpakxmrlz.
Nzawikr Pol Mz Nzyckqkr Drtwr Gct
Awibo mz Kxetu rgu Mevalu Jiszs, murde abr drtwrde ninge mz nzwztr-krbo bade, x axplrle ninge mz nzale-krnge nzwzngr lc.

A' mzli kc pnz pibqtix Kraes, x alex da kxkqlu kx aetq-ngrbo drtqde, x atrkati-zlwz-kzx doa nedeng. Kxmule-esz', a' Gct yckqti drtwrde ninge. Murde trkrlzwxu kx alex da kx vz-rbr, x rtrngzti-ngrbole mz nzvz-nqblq-krde trnzrlxngiti-krngeu.
A' zmrlz ngr Kxetu rgu sc tqmyatxlz-esz'ngr mz nzipq-krde ninge. X nzrka-krmle bange nzbrkr drtwr x nivz mz nzaxvctr-lzbq-krbo mz Mevalu Jiszs.
Da zpwxtx, x takitrde nzrlxngitingr mz nabz atwrnrngr kx Mevalu Jiszs vzm mz nrlc mz nzarlapx-krde kxnzaleng alwx. X ninge kx myapxbz mz alwx kcng tqale-zvzx mzli kc.

X Jiszs Kxnzmcpx trngyati-aniu drtwrde ninge mzli lc, kxmule-esz' myapxbo mz alwx rngeng. A' mcpxle ninge mz nzaelwapx-krde nzetukr zmrlz ngrde, mz nzarlapx-krde ninge mz alwx lcng. X nzarlapx-krde ninge lc tqaelwapx-kz-ngrde nzvqtikr drtqde nzarlapx-kz-krde leplz amrlx. Murde nalxngiti-kzlr nide x narmcti-kzlr nzlungr kxboi.

Mrlxnge Timoti, natqnge lcng nakabo bam nzvz-nqblqlr natq kcng tzpipx-pnzlr profet ngr lrmakxtr mz nzwzngr lc tqrtrngztipebzme. X na-aoti angidr drtwrm natq lcng, murde naxplrq mz nzota-krm mz nrlarde nyz Kxetu.
X nalolvz-amqngi-zvzq nzrlxngiti-krm, x nabzm nalqngi. Murde krkcng tzpxtxpx-ngrdrng nzrlxngiti-krdr yrkrpxpebz.
Kzdung nidr nzling drtqdr Haemznezs ncdr Aleksada. Aprcpebo nidr mz mq Setzn, murde drtwrdr naopx x nayrtqpx-lzbqng mz nzycmne-atrkati-krdr Gct.
